grammarFocus: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议。
title: The Community Garden Project
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文是关于一个社区花园项目的。请仔细阅读，并按照每个问题的要求作答。所有内容均为模拟教学材料。
passage:
A. Last year, the residents of Green Street wanted to improve their neighborhood. The local park was dirty and unsafe. There was rubbish everywhere, and the old playground equipment was broken. Many children played there, but their parents were worried. Therefore, the community center organized a meeting to discuss the problem.

B. At the meeting, people suggested different ideas. One person said, "We should build a community garden." Another person said, "We must clean the park first." Everyone agreed that the park needed to be safe. The community center manager explained, "If we work together, we can make the park beautiful again." She also said, "We should ask the city council for help because they own the land." The residents decided to write a letter to the city council.

C. The city council replied quickly. They said, "If you promise to take care of the garden, we will give you permission to use the land." The residents were very happy. They formed a gardening group and started to clean the park. They collected 20 bags of rubbish. Then they planted flowers and vegetables. They also built a new playground. The project took three months.

D. Now the park is clean and safe. Many families visit the garden every day. The children love the new playground. The residents are proud of their work. They say, "If we continue to work together, we will keep our neighborhood beautiful." The community center plans to hold a celebration party next month. They will invite all the volunteers because they worked very hard.

questions.prompt: Why did the community center organize a meeting?
options: To discuss the problem of the dirty and unsafe park.
To ask the city council for money.
answers: To discuss the problem of the dirty and unsafe park.
questions.explanation: 文章第一段提到社区中心组织会议讨论公园的问题。
questions.evidence: Therefore, the community center organized a meeting to discuss the problem.

questions.prompt: What did the residents decide to do after the meeting?
options: Write a letter to the city council.
answers: Write a letter to the city council.
questions.explanation: 第二段最后一句说居民决定给市议会写信。
questions.evidence: The residents decided to write a letter to the city council.

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what will the city council do if the residents promise to take care of the garden?
options: They will give them permission to use the land.
They will build a new playground.
answers: They will give them permission to use the land.
questions.explanation: 第三段中市议会回复说如果居民承诺照顾花园，就允许他们使用土地。
questions.evidence: If you promise to take care of the garden, we will give you permission to use the land.

questions.prompt: How long did the project take?
questions.explanation: 第三段最后一句提到项目花了三个月。

questions.prompt: What does the community center plan to do next month?
options: Write a letter to the city council.
questions.explanation: 最后一段提到社区中心计划下个月举办庆祝派对。
questions.evidence: The community center plans to hold a celebration party next month.

questions.prompt: The residents collected 20 bags of rubbish.
questions.explanation: 第三段明确说他们收集了20袋垃圾。

questions.prompt: The city council paid for the new playground.
questions.explanation: 文章没有提到谁支付了新游乐设施的费用。
questions.evidence: 文章未提及支付新游乐设施费用的信息。

questions.prompt: The park was clean and safe before the project started.
questions.explanation: 第一段说公园又脏又不安全，所以这个说法是错误的。
questions.evidence: The local park was dirty and unsafe.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: The residents formed a gardening group and started to ______ the park.
questions.explanation: 第三段提到居民组成园艺小组并开始打扫公园。
questions.evidence: They formed a gardening group and started to clean the park.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: The children love the new ______.
questions.explanation: 第四段说孩子们喜欢新游乐场。
questions.evidence: The children love the new playground.

vocabulary.example: The residents of Green Street wanted to improve their neighborhood.
The local park was dirty and unsafe.
The community center organized a meeting.
We will give you permission to use the land.

The residents wanted to improve their neighborhood.

grammar.title: 第一条件句与情态动词建议
grammar.explanation: 第一条件句表示将来可能发生的事，结构是：If + 一般现在时，主语 + will + 动词原形。例如：If we work together, we can make the park beautiful again. 情态动词 should 表示建议，must 表示必须。例如：We should ask the city council for help. We must clean the park first.
grammar.example: If you promise to take care of the garden, we will give you permission to use the land.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ at home.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句中，主句用 will + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

questions.prompt: You ______ see a doctor because you look sick.
questions.explanation: should 表示建议，这里建议去看医生。
questions.evidence: You should see a doctor because you look sick.

questions.prompt: We ______ hurry because the train leaves in ten minutes.
questions.explanation: must 表示必须，因为火车十分钟后出发。
questions.evidence: We must hurry because the train leaves in ten minutes.

questions.prompt: If you study hard, you ______ the exam.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句中，主句用 will + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
